derivation: (Aramaic) from H1922 (הֲדַר)lemma הֲדַּר extra dagesh, corrected to הֲדַר;

occurrences.text: At the same time my reason returned unto me; and for the glory of my kingdom, mine honour and brightness returned unto me; and my counsellors and my lords sought unto me; and I was established in my kingdom, and excellent majesty was added unto me.
